Markdown processing sits behind an interface. Which concrete implementation(s) execute at runtime, who constructs them, and which components hold the interface?

content:
h13.

**`*markdown.service` (the only implementation) — built once by `markdown.NewService(...)` inside `NewAPIV1Service` — held by `APIV1Service`, `RSSService`, and `memopayload.Runner`.**

### The interface
`markdown.Service` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:31` — 8 methods: `ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`, `GenerateSnippet`, `ValidateContent`, `RenameTag`.

### Implementation (single, unexported)
`markdown.service` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58` — wraps a `goldmark.Markdown` instance (`md` field). No second implementation and no mock/fake exists: a repo-wide search for `markdown.Service` returns only field declarations and parameters, never another concrete type. Method bodies live at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:244` (`RenderMarkdown`, which delegates to `renderer.NewMarkdownRenderer()` at `internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:20`), `:255` (`RenderHTML` via `s.md.Convert`), `:264` (`GenerateSnippet`), `:356` (`ExtractAll`).

### Construction
- Production: `markdown.NewService(markdown.WithTagExtension(), markdown.WithMentionExtension())` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51`, inside `NewAPIV1Service`. `NewService` returns the interface type but always builds `&service{md: md}` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:85-113`), configuring GFM plus the tag/mention extensions.
- That single instance is then **shared**, not re-created: `server/server.go:85` passes `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` into `rss.NewRSSService(...)`.
- Test-only constructions: `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go:427` (tags only), `server/router/rss/rss_test.go:54` (no extensions).

### Holders
| Holder | Anchor | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` | `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35` | mention extraction (`memo_mention_helpers.go:32`), snippet for webhooks (`memo_service_webhooks.go:85`), payload rebuild on create/update (`memo_service.go:108`, `:447`) |
| `RSSService.MarkdownService` | `server/router/rss/rss.go:45` | server-side HTML for feed item descriptions (`rss.go:339`) |
| `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` | `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16` | batch payload rebuild (`runner.go:52`) |
| `RebuildMemoPayload(..., markdownService)` | `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74` | passed by value, called with `s.MarkdownService` from the API layer |

One wiring caveat: `memopayload.NewRunner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:19`) has **no callers** — the graph certifies zero. So the `Runner` holder is currently unwired; the runner's package reaches runtime only through the free function `RebuildMemoPayload`, invoked with the API service's instance.

Separately, frontend markdown rendering does not go through this interface — it's a React/markdown-it path (`web/src/components/MemoContent/MemoMarkdownRenderer.tsx:56`), which is why the Go interface doc at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:28-30` scopes `RenderHTML` to RSS and other server-side needs.
